title: Lab Defaults
description: Smart defaults for the lab lifecycle wizard. Place as lab-defaults.json in hackcontent/<slug>/lab/. Only include fields you want to override — missing fields are ignored.

$schema.description: Optional URI of the lab-defaults JSON schema. Defaults to the schema published in microsoft/MicroHack.

Quality.description: Optional quality (maturity) label of the content pack. When set, importing or refreshing the content pack in the platform updates its quality label to this value; an invalid value is reported as a warning and ignored. When absent, the quality label is left as it is. Only honored for content imported from the main branch of microsoft/MicroHack (or the master branch of microsoft/WhatTheHack): other repositories and branches are always labelled Testing, and custom repository imports never set the label automatically.

groups.description: Group-based feature activation names. Each group provisions a feature for the created Entra ID users: GHCPUsers = GitHub Copilot license, M365-E5-Users = Microsoft 365 E5 license. Names are case-sensitive. An empty string (the template placeholder) is ignored.

labsPerSubscription.description: Number of lab environments to pack per Azure subscription.

preferredLocation.description: Comma-separated list of preferred Azure regions, in priority order (e.g. "swedencentral, norwayeast").

estimatedDailyCostsUsd.description: Estimated daily cost per lab environment in USD: the running cost of the resources deploy-lab.ps1 creates. Used for cost forecasting in the lab lifecycle wizard. Defaults to 25 when absent or < 1.

estimatedSharedDeploymentDailyCostsUsd.description: Estimated daily cost in USD of the resources shared-deploy-lab.ps1 creates. That hook runs once per Azure subscription, so this is multiplied by the subscription count: labs / labsPerSubscription (rounded up) for deploymentType resourcegroup and resourcegroup-with-subscriptionowner, or one per lab for deploymentType subscription. Defaults to 0 when absent or negative.

estimatedGlobalDeploymentDailyCostsUsd.description: Estimated daily cost in USD of the event-wide resources global-event-deploy.ps1 creates. That hook runs once per event (before shared-deploy-lab.ps1), so this is added once per day of the event, whatever the lab or subscription count. Required for the hook to run: global-event-deploy.ps1 is skipped with a warning unless its param block is ([string]$SubscriptionId, [string[]]$PreferredLocation, [string[]]$AllowedEntraUserIds) and this is greater than 5; at 5 or less no cost is estimated either. Re-import the content pack after enabling it.

contentPreparation.description: Optional. How the platform prepares this hack on import and re-import. Every property is optional: an absent property keeps the platform default (microhack-variants.json / whatthehack-variants.json in the platform), a present one replaces that default as a whole and an empty list or object clears it. Paths are literal and case-sensitive, use '/' as separator and stay inside their folder: wildcards, '..', absolute paths and links are rejected. An invalid section fails the import of this hack before anything is published.

variants.description: Variants offered in the import dialog. An empty list offers none.

defaultVariant.description: Variant used when none is chosen. Must be one of the variants; defaults to the first one.

alwaysRemove.description: Files or folders removed whatever the variant, per folder.

variantRemovals.description: Markdown files (.md) removed from challenges and solutions when a variant is chosen. Key = variant. Folders and other file types are not allowed: use alwaysRemove for those.

variantRenames.description: Markdown files renamed in challenges and solutions when a variant is chosen. Key = variant, value = { "source .md path": "new .md file name" }; a file is renamed within its own folder.

studentZipExclusions.description: Paths left out of download-Student.zip, as they appear inside the ZIP (a bare name is a top-level entry).

coachZipExclusions.description: Paths left out of download-Coach.zip, as they appear inside the ZIP (a bare name is a top-level entry).

banners.description: Banners injected below the title of the first challenge and the first solution.

variantName.description: Letters, digits, space, '.', '_' or '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. Case-sensitive.

literalPath.description: Literal relative path, '/'-separated and case-sensitive. A bare name matches the shallowest entry with that exact name; a path with '/' matches exactly. No wildcards or pattern characters (* ? < > " | : [ ]), no '\', no '.' or '..', no leading '/', no name ending in '.' or a space.

literalName.description: Literal file name without '/', same rules as a path.

markdownPath.description: Literal path (see literalPath) to a Markdown file: the last name ends in '.md' (any case).

markdownName.description: Literal Markdown file name (see literalName) ending in '.md' (any case).

download.description: [!IMPORTANT] banner linking the download ZIP. Default: true.

parentReadme.description: [!TIP] banner pointing to the Readme of the challenges or solutions folder. Default: true for MicroHack-style hacks, false for WhatTheHack.
